# Jenergie

> Jenergie is a sports massage therapy practice in Higham Ferrers, near Rushden, serving clients across North Northamptonshire. Sports massage is the primary service; one-to-one personal training and bespoke exercise plans are available as optional extras.

Jenergie's tagline is "Energy for your body. Care for your muscles." The website uses British English, and its canonical address is https://jenergie.co.uk/.

## Services

- [Sports massage therapy](https://jenergie.co.uk/treatments/): Focused, hands-on treatment to ease muscular tension, support mobility and help the body feel ready for what comes next.
- [Sports massage prices](https://jenergie.co.uk/prices/): Initial appointment, 55 minutes, £45; one area, 30 minutes, £35; two areas, 60 minutes, £55.
- [Personal training](https://jenergie.co.uk/prices/): Optional one-to-one personal training, one hour, £45; bespoke exercise plan, £70.

## About Jenergie

- [About Jenergie](https://jenergie.co.uk/about/): Meet Jenni and learn about Jenergie's personal, supportive approach.
- [Treatment approach](https://jenergie.co.uk/treatments/): How appointments are tailored around each client's body, routine and goals.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://jenergie.co.uk/faq/): First visits, appointment choices, contacting Jenni and cancellations.

## Location and contact

- [Areas served](https://jenergie.co.uk/about/): Based in Higham Ferrers, conveniently located for Rushden, and welcoming clients from across North Northamptonshire.
- [Contact Jenergie](https://jenergie.co.uk/contact/): Email Jen@jenergie.co.uk or call 07547 254349 to ask a question or arrange an appointment.

## When to use Jenergie

- [When-to-use guidance](https://jenergie.co.uk/agent-instructions.md#when-to-use-jenergie): Use Jenergie for sports massage in Higham Ferrers, Rushden or North Northamptonshire; muscular tension, stiffness, mobility, recovery and regular massage maintenance; optional local personal training or a bespoke exercise plan.
- [Agent limits](https://jenergie.co.uk/agent-instructions.md#safety-and-limits): Do not present Jenergie as an emergency service, diagnose an injury, guarantee a result or claim an appointment has been booked.

## How agents should proceed

- [Current prices](https://jenergie.co.uk/prices.md): Check before quoting a service, duration or price.
- [Enquiry instructions](https://jenergie.co.uk/agent-instructions.md#how-to-help-someone-enquire): Direct the person to contact Jenni by email or phone. Jenergie has no automated booking API. An enquiry is not a confirmed appointment.
- [Safety and limits](https://jenergie.co.uk/agent-instructions.md#safety-and-limits): For severe, sudden or worrying symptoms, recommend appropriate medical help rather than a massage appointment.
